page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g7nex.8xlarge is an x86_64 general-purpose instance in the Enhanced server family, running on the KVM hypervisor. Compute is provisioned through 32 dedicated vCPUs powered by Intel Xeon 8369B processors operating at a base frequency of 2.7 GHz. System memory is sized at 128.0 GB, establishing a balanced 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio of 4.0 GB per vCPU. Hardware accelerators are not present, with zero physical or virtual GPUs attached.

Storage and networking configurations follow a decoupled infrastructure design. The instance contains no bundled local storage, requiring all persistent data volumes and root operating system disks to be provisioned via remote block storage. For network traffic, the platform provides a 40 Gbps baseline network bandwidth capacity. No complimentary public IPv4 addresses are assigned to the instance by default.

In terms of resource allocation, the platform provides dedicated core capacity suitable for sustained utilization without burst constraints. Given its standard compute-to-memory proportions and high network throughput, ecs.g7nex.8xlarge is structured for multi-threaded backend services, enterprise application hosts, relational database engines using attached network storage, and continuous integration pipelines.
